about_the_game:
Welcome to the Dark Dungeon

Step into a dungeon where deadly creatures and ancient evil lurk in the shadows. As you fight against endless waves of ninjas, quick reflexes, sharp strategy, and your survival instincts will be your only lifeline.

To become the master of the dungeon, collect gold, upgrade your weapons and abilities, eliminate your enemies, and face the demonic bosses that seek to claim your soul. But beware – with every wave, your foes grow stronger, and danger awaits at every turn.

Stunning Visuals

Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of the dungeon, brought to life through detailed pixel art design. With meticulously crafted animations and stunning visual effects, every battle offers a unique experience.

A Wide Arsenal

In Soul of the Dungeon, mastering different weapons is key to survival. Each weapon has its own unique attack style and strategic advantages.

Fast, Fast Paced...

Jump into the action instantly! Quick Gameplay allows you to quickly reach the depths of the dungeon, face hordes of enemies and engage in thrilling battles.

Fluid and Dynamic Combat

Engage in strategic battles, dodge enemy attacks, wield powerful weapons, and turn the tide with your abilities. Every hit, dodge, and strike is carefully designed to deliver an immersive combat experience.

Epic Boss Battles

In the depths of the dungeon, powerful and terrifying bosses await. Each boss has unique attack mechanics, requiring precise strategy to defeat. But be warned, each boss fight will push your limits to the edge!

Rogue-Lite Experience

With each wave becoming tougher, more complex, and deadlier, gather gold, upgrade your strength, enhance your abilities, and push further with every attempt. Death is inevitable, but every lesson learned makes you stronger.

Powerful Spells & Ability Cards

Turn the tide of battle in your favor by collecting mystical chests that contain special ability cards. These will grant you unique spells and abilities, allowing you to shape your combat style.

Gameplay Features

  • Wave-based rogue-lite action – Every wave is tougher, every run is different.

  • Intense and strategic combat – Master movement and attack patterns to survive.

  • Epic boss fights – Face challenging bosses, each with their own unique attacks.

  • Powerful abilities and spells – Discover game-changing skills from mystical chests.

  • Pixel art graphics – A dark, atmospheric visual experience.

The dungeon calls for your soul. Become stronger, survive, and rise as the ultimate warrior in Soul of the Dungeon.
